GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 000.5 (24 Aug 46) LS-R
(SCAPIN - 1153)
APO 500
24 August 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Suspected War Criminal.
Memorandum to the Imperial Japanese Government, dated 15 July 1946, file AG 000.5 (15 Jul 46) LS., wherein the Imperial Japanese Government is directed to deliver one KAGAWA, Chiyozo, Civilian Guard, to the Commanding General, EIGHTH Army, at Sugamo Prison (Tokyo Detention Camp), at the earliest practicable date, is hereby amended to delete said KAGAWA's name. This name appears as the 3rd name on page No. 2 of the above mentioned Memorandum.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
JOHN B. COOLEY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
